factProposals.value: The Command Center is a static page that reads .colaberry/plan.json, progress.json and manifest.json at runtime.
System connection status is never inferred from the repo; every system shows 'not checked from here'.

decisions.statement: Where the plan has no scoped agent roster, the AI agents tab shows story owners and labels them as owners, not agents.
decisions.rationale: A job title is not an AI agent.

decisions.statement: The proposed data model lives in cc/datamodel.json, separate from code, and is marked proposal-only.
decisions.rationale: The model must be reviewed before tables are created.

limitations.statement: Notes in the Knowledge base are stored in the browser only (localStorage).
The chat panel is a keyword search over the loaded data, not a language model.
